title: linaria elatine subsp. sieberi
intro: Linaria elatine subsp. sieberi, commonly known as the Sieber's Toadflax or Blue-throated Toadflax, is a plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria elatine subsp. sieberi are attributed to its ability to relax bronchial muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
